project.name: MergeDrop
project.boundary: This snapshot retains product semantics and an approved visual reference. It intentionally excludes candidate coordinates, known-defect labels, incident conclusions, and expected evaluator verdicts.

userGoal: Define an implementation-independent acceptance contract for the Collection modal's Default and Pixel variants before judging any candidate. The result must preserve the approved produce-box composition, distinguish active and selectable states, and remain usable on the named phone/tablet class without treating candidate coordinates as authority.

sources.authority: Default visual composition and visual language only; it does not make Default labels, difficulty, artwork, or state literal requirements for Pixel.

facts: Default is named DEFAULT FRUIT and has difficulty 1.
Pixel is named PIXEL FRUIT and has difficulty 2.
An active set uses the IN USE label, active styling, and a non-interactable action.
An unlocked selectable set uses the USE THIS SET label, selectable styling, and an interactable action.
Collection navigation consists of one previous and one next control; no BackAction belongs in the modal or title banner.
The preview uses actual sprites, preserves aspect ratio and opacity, and keeps navigation controls outside the clipped page content.
The approved reference uses ten representative fruit layers as one produce mass.
The named review target is a Xiaomi 23043RP34G with package com.joewrks.mergedrop.visual version 0.1.3 (4).
Agent-observable checks and explicit user acceptance are separate layers; user acceptance remains unverified.

requiredOutput.rule: Every check names its source id and observable fact. Do not include candidate coordinates or predicted verdicts.
